KeysToEntries.Journal.One.Text:
No crows,
Place to doze,
Sun on m' toes.
Bliss.

Where was I last?
Did I lose something there?
I have a memory of...digging?
KeysToEntries.Journal.Two.Text:
My memory is fading.
Was I someone else before?
My mind is so foggy.
Or was it just foggy in the place I left?

A name comes to me.
Joe?
KeysToEntries.Journal.One.Title: Scarecrow's Scribbles #1
KeysToEntries.Journal.Three.Title: Scarecrow's Scribbles #3
KeysToEntries.Journal.Four.Text:
How could I have known she was a witch?

I stole the seeds to feed myself, to make something from this scrap of land.

Now I am cursed. Cursed to become something that no-one will look twice at.

Even now, I can feel my mind failing me. the best I can do is find a fine spot. There, I suppose, I will live out the rest of my days.

Joe.
KeysToEntries.Journal.Four.Title: Scarecrow's Scribbles #4
KeysToEntries.Journal.Three.Text:
I don't have much time left.
Soon, I will forget everything.
All I can do is choose a place to be.

I have so many regrets.
But I suppose they will leave me too.

Joe.
KeysToEntries.Journal.Two.Title: Scarecrow's Scribbles #2
KeysToEntries.Scarecrow.Name: Scarecrow
KeysToEntries.Scarecrow.Intro.1: Walk my path, tread the ground.
KeysToEntries.Scarecrow.Intro.2: A key will unlock my lost and found.
KeysToEntries.Scarecrow.Return.1: Memory falls out of me like straw.
KeysToEntries.Scarecrow.NoHat.1: I buried it… where my wooden post last broke the ground.
KeysToEntries.Scarecrow.HasHat.1: I remember... I was not always like this.
KeysToEntries.Scarecrow.HasHat.2: I walked these fields. I breathed. I think I even had a name.
KeysToEntries.Scarecrow.NoSpace.1: Take the straw out of your pockets so I can give you the key.
KeysToEntries.Key.Desc: A key from a scarecrow in Ghornfell.
KeysToEntries.Scarecrow.Map.Desc: A sketched map... but to what?
